decisions.statement: The rules a person wrote are looked in before the controlled ones.
The id is said as a word and both shape flags at their own.
A call saying no id is refused, asking for the id by its placeholder.
A flag this takes none of is refused, naming the three ways this is said.
Both shape flags carry no value, so a value joined to either is refused.
A shape flag said twice is refused rather than read once.
`--json` is declared, so it is taken rather than refused as one this takes none of.
A controlled rule's id is `controlled:` and what that rule was worked out from.
An id no category rule carries refuses the call.
The rule is answered as JSON whether or not `--json` is said, so `--json` changes nothing.
`--tsv` is the flag choosing the shape of this answer.

definition: the command giving back one category rule named by its id
